review_text: I recently visited Pick Up Coffee at the Finance Center. During my visit, the branch was managed by just one staff member, and he did a great job handling everything efficiently. The place is air-conditioned, clean, and comfortable—perfect for a quick coffee break. The coffee is affordable and tastes good. While it’s not a premium coffee experience, it definitely delivers good value for the price. I ordered a Spanish Latte paired with a croissant, and they went well together. The staff was friendly and accommodating, which made the visit even more pleasant. Overall, it’s a good spot if you’re looking for an affordable coffee fix in a clean and convenient location. Recommended for students, office workers, and anyone who enjoys a simple coffee break.

Pickup Coffee DAVAO FINANCE CENTER ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ My favorite coffee chain! Always smooth, tasty, and never bitter—their iced oranges americano is superb. Fast service, friendly staff and Supervisor and affordable prices. Highly recommended!
